/obj/item/autosurgeon.name: autosurgeon
/obj/item/autosurgeon.reason: Empty and reusable. Load an organ or ordinary implant and it goes in with no surgeon, at once on yourself and in 8 seconds on someone else. Cyberware refuses it. Two vouchers at a red-zone clinic.

/obj/item/autosurgeon/medical_hud.name: autosurgeon
/obj/item/autosurgeon/medical_hud.reason: A one-use injector for the medical HUD implant, same green tier as the goggles. Found in the chief medical locker on two hulls.

/obj/item/autosurgeon/syndicate/commsage.name: suspicious autosurgeon
/obj/item/autosurgeon/syndicate/commsage.reason: An injector that only fits tongues. A ruin curiosity with no power.

/obj/item/implant/beacon.name: beacon implant
/obj/item/implant/beacon.note: Makes the host a selectable destination on teleporter consoles and an entry on the teleport locator, while alive and for 10 minutes after death; the prisoner management console reports whether they are in a safe or hazardous spot.
/obj/item/implant/beacon.reason: Makes the host a teleporter destination, until 10 minutes after death. Needs a teleporter, and teleports can't cross zones.

/obj/item/implant/chem.name: chem implant
/obj/item/implant/chem.note: Holds up to 50 units of reagents (loaded with a syringe while still in its case); the prisoner management console injects 1, 5 or 10 units into the host on demand, and the remaining load is injected when the host dies. The implant breaks once it is empty.
/obj/item/implant/chem.reason: Holds 50 units of chemicals that a prison console injects on demand, the rest on death. A jailer's tool that needs the console.

/obj/item/implant/deathrattle.name: deathrattle implant
/obj/item/implant/deathrattle.note: When a host dies, every other host in the same implant group is told their name and location. An implant not registered to a group, such as one from a random spawner, does nothing; groups come from the syndicate deathrattle box (eight linked implants) and station traits.
/obj/item/implant/deathrattle.reason: Tells its wearer when a crewmate dies, and where. Crewmates don't need one.

/obj/item/implant/explosive.name: microbomb implant
/obj/item/implant/explosive.note: Detonates when the host triggers it (with a confirmation prompt) or dies, gibbing the host; blast radii after rounding are 0 devastation, 1 heavy and 2 light, with fire and flash out to 2. Several in one host merge into a bigger blast with a longer, beeping fuse during which the host is paralyzed.
/obj/item/implant/explosive.reason: Gibs you when you trigger it or die, hitting anyone next to you hard and those within 2 tiles lightly. Punishes melee and denies your body, at the cost of any revive.

/obj/item/implant/mindshield.name: mindshield implant
/obj/item/implant/mindshield.note: Gives the host the mindshield and unconvertible traits: it blocks conversion and mind-linking, shows a mindshield mark on security HUDs, lowers their security-bot threat score by 1, and turrets set to target non-mindshielded people skip them.
/obj/item/implant/mindshield.reason: Blocks conversion, and this game has no converters. Turrets and bots rarely care. Costs one neural load.

/obj/item/implant/radio.name: internal radio implant
/obj/item/implant/radio.reason: A radio that can't be taken off you. Small comfort after you're stripped. Ruin only.

/obj/item/implant/sad_trombone.name: sad trombone implant
/obj/item/implant/sad_trombone.note: Plays a sad trombone sound at the host's location whenever they make a death-gasp emote.
/obj/item/implant/sad_trombone.reason: Plays a sad trombone when you die. A joke.

/obj/item/implant/teleport_blocker.name: bluespace grounding implant
/obj/item/implant/teleport_blocker.note: Cancels any teleport of the host with a spark flash, paralyzes them for 5 seconds and tells them they were flung back. Jaunting is blocked the same way, with the same 5 second paralysis.
/obj/item/implant/teleport_blocker.reason: Cancels any teleport of the host and paralyzes them for 5 s. A way to keep prisoners put, and a drawback for anyone else.

/obj/item/implant/vex_insurance.name: Vex's insurance implant
/obj/item/implant/vex_insurance.note: One use: the first time the host drops into soft or hard crit (not plain unconsciousness or an instant death) it heals 40 oxygen, 10 toxin, 15 brute and 15 burn damage and injects 10u epinephrine, then 10 seconds later teleports them to their registered ship (beside a cryopod, else any open deck tile) whether or not they are still alive. With no registered ship it only stabilizes; the implant burns out either way.
/obj/item/implant/vex_insurance.reason: One use: when you drop into crit it heals a little, then 10 s later teleports you to your ship, alive or not. A guaranteed way out of a lost fight. If the ship is in another zone it stays unspent and tries again next time.

/obj/item/implant/weapons_auth.name: firearms authentication implant
/obj/item/implant/weapons_auth.reason: Unlocks guns keyed to the implant, and crews' guns aren't. One ruin has it.

/obj/item/implantcase.name: implant case
/obj/item/implantcase.reason: An empty glass case for implants.

/obj/item/implantcase/beacon.name: implant case - 'Beacon'
/obj/item/implantcase/beacon.reason: Holds a beacon implant, which makes the host a teleporter destination.

/obj/item/implantcase/chem.name: implant case - 'Remote Chemical'
/obj/item/implantcase/chem.reason: Holds a remote chemical implant, a jailer's tool that needs a prison console.

/obj/item/implantcase/deathrattle.name: implant case - 'Deathrattle'
/obj/item/implantcase/deathrattle.reason: Holds a deathrattle implant, which reports crew deaths to its wearer.

/obj/item/implantcase/exile.name: implant case - 'Exile'
/obj/item/implantcase/exile.reason: Holds an exile implant, which only matters for gateways this game doesn't use.

/obj/item/implantcase/mindshield.name: implant case - 'Mindshield'
/obj/item/implantcase/mindshield.reason: Holds a mindshield implant, which does almost nothing in a game with no antagonists.

/obj/item/implantcase/sad_trombone.name: implant case - 'Sad Trombone'
/obj/item/implantcase/sad_trombone.reason: Holds a sad trombone implant. A joke.

/obj/item/implantcase/teleport_blocker.name: implant case - 'Bluespace Grounding'
/obj/item/implantcase/teleport_blocker.reason: Holds a bluespace grounding implant, a way to stop a prisoner being teleported out.

/obj/item/implantcase/tracking.name: implant case - 'Tracking'
/obj/item/implantcase/tracking.reason: Holds a tracking implant, so a locator shows where the host is. Useful on a captive, costs about 2 cr.

/obj/item/implantcase/weapons_auth.name: implant case - 'Firearms Authentication'
/obj/item/implantcase/weapons_auth.reason: Holds a firearms authentication implant, which unlocks guns crews don't use.

/obj/item/implanter/explosive.name: implanter (microbomb)
/obj/item/implanter/explosive.reason: Holds a microbomb implant, a suicide blast on death. Only from an exploration drone's shady merchant, for a spare organ.

/obj/item/implanter/mindshield.name: implanter (mindshield)
/obj/item/implanter/mindshield.reason: Holds a mindshield implant, which does almost nothing in a game with no antagonists.

/obj/item/implanter/radio.name: implanter (internal radio)
/obj/item/implanter/radio.reason: Holds an internal radio implant, a radio that can't be taken off you. Ruin only.

/obj/item/implanter/vex_insurance.name: implanter (Vex's insurance)
/obj/item/implanter/vex_insurance.reason: Holds Vex's insurance implant, a one-use escape from crit back to your ship. 3,000 cr plus 3 vouchers at reputation 22, three per crew.

/obj/item/implantpad.name: implant pad
/obj/item/implantpad.note: Holds one implant case and shows the implant's specification sheet in a window; it cannot change the implant.
/obj/item/implantpad.reason: Shows an implant's spec sheet. Changes nothing.

/obj/item/skillchip/acrobatics.name: old F058UR7 skillchip
/obj/item/skillchip/acrobatics.note: Removes the cooldown on the spin and flip emotes for the first 5 uses (one use returns every 10 seconds). Further uses cost the chip 1 of its 100 integrity each and roll for sparks, a shock with brain damage, head fire, or, at low integrity, the chip bursting the host's head (small explosion, cranial fissure); the chip regenerates integrity slowly while installed.
/obj/item/skillchip/acrobatics.reason: Extra flips and spins, and overuse can burst your head. A joke.

/obj/item/skillchip/appraiser.name: GENUINE ID Appraisal Now! skillchip
/obj/item/skillchip/appraiser.reason: Tells real IDs from printed ones. Flavor.

/obj/item/skillchip/big_pointer.name: Kommand skillchip
/obj/item/skillchip/big_pointer.note: Pointing makes a larger arrow, and a button lets the user pick a custom colour for it.

/obj/item/skillchip/brainwashing.name: suspicious skillchip
/obj/item/skillchip/brainwashing.note: Installing it deals 20 brain damage to the host. Lets them start a washing machine cycle that returns a brain inside undamaged with all traumas cured, where an ordinary wash kills the brain.
/obj/item/skillchip/brainwashing.reason: Lets a washing machine cure a brain of all traumas, at 20 brain damage to install. A party trick.

/obj/item/skillchip/chefs_kiss.name: K1SS skillchip
/obj/item/skillchip/chefs_kiss.reason: Kiss your cooking for a mood bump.

/obj/item/skillchip/entrails_reader.name: 3NTR41LS skillchip
/obj/item/skillchip/entrails_reader.reason: Read a person's history from their organs. Flavor.

/obj/item/skillchip/intj.name: Integrated Intuitive Thinking and Judging skillchip
/obj/item/skillchip/intj.reason: Taste food by looking at it.

/obj/item/skillchip/master_angler.name: Mast-Angl-Er skillchip
/obj/item/skillchip/master_angler.reason: Hints and fish lists while fishing. Small help to a hobby.

/obj/item/skillchip/matrix_taunt.name: BULLET_DODGER skillchip
/obj/item/skillchip/matrix_taunt.note: Using the taunt emote makes the host immune to projectile hits for 1.35 seconds and costs 19 stamina damage; the taunt is refused if it would take them to stamina crit.
/obj/item/skillchip/matrix_taunt.reason: Taunt for 1.35 s of immunity to bullets at 19 stamina a go. Timed well it beats any gun. 1,500 bitrunning points from a console few crews will run.

/obj/item/skillchip/research_director.name: R.D.S.P.L.X. skillchip
/obj/item/skillchip/research_director.reason: Lets you handle an immovable-object novelty from a ruin. Flavor.

/obj/item/skillchip/self_surgery.name: 4U70-P3R4710N skillchip
/obj/item/skillchip/self_surgery.reason: No effect here: everyone can already operate on themselves.

/obj/item/skillchip/useless_adapter.name: Skillchip adapter
/obj/item/skillchip/useless_adapter.reason: Holds another skillchip for no reason.

method: Judged by hand against each other and against the cyberware and eyewear anchors. Cases, implanters and autosurgeons are rated as what they hold. Every implant costs 1 neural load. Skillchips are none unless they change a fight.
